objective: Infer synchronous set-comprehension result types for typed iterable inputs and propagate those types to assignment and generic-call constraints

inputs.name: typed-result-controls
assignment-propagation
generic-argument-propagation
dependent-generators-and-isolation

original_contract.expected_derivation: Fresh admitted original captures only; preserve exact raw stdout, stderr, process exit, imports, runtime/pin/source/argv/environment identities and pre/post source bytes
original_contract.python314: Root-reviewed fresh capture on admitted reconstructed runtime; do not reuse historical runtime identity or replace provenance with semantic match

native_contract.baseline: Root must retain native failures before applying product changes
native_contract.semantic_output: Set container with typed element; propagate to assignments and generic calls without leaking comprehension bindings
native_contract.comparison: All diagnostic fields, positions, hints, checked-file counts and reporter exits against fresh originals
native_contract.public_completion: Preserve Incomplete/null for nonblocking cases; do not close the broader complete contract
